coverage: All 12 presets through preserve and srgb backends; exact background and original photo samples checked
Preset selection takes priority over manual values; commenting the selection enables manual values; reload clears the old selection
Default video export, adaptive combined export, original batch export, and invalid-color output protection
Signature white-paper mask, transparent alpha, per-item overrides, cache isolation and unchanged logos
16-bit P3 preservation, metadata, layout, Finder entry points and installation/uninstallation regression tests
limitations: Full runtime suite executed on macOS 14.8.9 Apple Silicon with Python 3.14.2 only.
Python 3.10 syntax was checked, but other Python versions and Intel Macs were not rerun for this release.
Finder registration was tested in temporary directories; first-use UI on a fresh macOS account was not rechecked.
